Soviet naval command appears to be operating along two lines of effort: disruption of coalition shipping through the central Indian Ocean and selective strikes against austere ports and forward staging sites in the eastern archipelago.2. SIGINT and patrol aircraft reporting indicate at least one major surface action group remains eastbound after refueling, while subordinate raider elements are screening the Sunda, Lombok, and Malacca approaches.3. Recommended action: preserve heavy escorts for decisive action, use submarines and maritime patrol aircraft aggressively against logistics nodes, and deny the enemy freedom of movement inside the choke points.
